messages:
maria (marketing): Quick question — can we lock publish time for the Redwood Optimize launch blog? Aiming for next Tue to give sales time to prep leads.

alexa (growth): Tue works. I vote 9:00 AM PT so we hit US morning + APAC late afternoon.

rishi (product): Good for product. Need to confirm the headline benchmark number — do we have final 2.3x latency improvement vs baseline? :thinking_face:

taylor (growthops): Also: can we include an explicit webinar CTA in the hero and an early-access signup? Growth recommends A/B subject line test + include a `utm_campaign=optimize_launch` param.

kate (legal): Quick legal pass: we need a citation for the 2.3x claim and a short footnote for methodology. Also avoid absolute phrases like "always" or "zero errors".

maria (marketing): I'll add the benchmark footnote that links to the eval slate. Proposed publish timestamp: `2026-03-31 09:00 PT` (that's `2026-03-31T16:00:00Z`). Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if OK.

alexa (growth): thumbs up. I'll queue the social schedule once publish-bot confirms assets.

publish-bot: Assets checklist — missing: `og:image`, hero quote (50–80 chars), and final `alt` text for images. Run `/schedule publish 2026-03-31T16:00Z` after assets uploaded.

taylor (growthops): Subject line A: "Redwood Optimize: Cut inference cost by 36% — see the benchmark"

taylor (growthops): Subject line B: "How we reduced LLM latency 2.3x — Redwood Optimize launch"

rishi (product): I'll own the landing page + webinar registration. @maria can you share the hero quote? I'll add the webinar widget and set `lead_flow=webinar-early` in HubSpot.

maria (marketing): Hero quote draft: "Optimize inference — faster responses, lower unit costs." Will tighten.

taylor (growthops): Routing rules for HubSpot (draft): `if source=launch_post -> list: Launch-Optimize; if interest contains "dedicated" -> assign tag: sales_dedicated; if clicks webinar CTA -> add lifecycle stage: MQL`

kate (legal): I reviewed routing copy. Fine. Provide link to benchmark doc and methodology before publish.

alexa (growth): Small ops ask — can we include an experiment parameter in links so we can attribute A/B (e.g., `?utm_experiment=subjA`).

maria (marketing): Noted. Final checklist: publish time set to `2026-03-31T16:00Z`, assets uploaded (og image + hero quote + alt text), benchmark footnote linked, hubspot routing rules applied, subject A/B ready. Please :thumbsup: by EOD Fri to lock.

kate (legal): :thumbsup: done.

alexa (growth): :thumbsup:

taylor (growthops): :thumbsup:

rishi (product): :thumbsup:

maria (marketing): Great — locking schedule Friday if no objections. Thanks all!
